name: Entertainment
theme: film, television, music and theatre from the twentieth century to the present: the works themselves, the people who made them, and the stories behind how they were made
angles: the director, author or composer behind a work everyone knows
the actor behind a character, or the character behind an actor
opening and closing lines people can quote but cannot place
the decade a landmark film, album or show arrived
the real name behind a stage name
theme tunes and scores, and who wrote them
the book, play or true story a film was adapted from
sequels and spin-offs, and the order things actually happened in
a role that was famously turned down, recast or nearly went elsewhere
stage musicals and the films they became, or the other way round
acts known for one song, and the song
animated films and the studio behind them
the city or era a well known show is set in
records and firsts that have stood for decades
blockbuster movies, chart topping songs, best selling plays
famous movie quotes - guess the movie
famous song lyrics - guess the song
the plot of a movie or book, described without naming it, and ask for the title
avoid: current charts and streaming numbers that are currently changing, anything released in the last year, celebrity personal lives, plot spoilers, and questions where a remake and its original would both fit the description
